title: 通用桌面操作 helper（Swift）与构建集成

design: one process per command; stdout is strict JSON; parent-exit watchdog prevents orphans
global top-left logical coordinates on the wire; CGEvent bottom-left conversion inside
private CGEventSource; down events carry explicit modifier flags, up events explicitly empty (M01/E14)
screen capture via SCContentFilter/SCScreenshotManager with pointPixelScale (M01/E18)
permission gates emit structured system-permission-required JSON and exit 3; usage errors exit 2

commands: swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos14 (direct + via node --test compile step)
npm --prefix apps/electron test (full electron suite, packaged dsh env)

results.liveReadOnlyChecks: permissions reports 2 displays (primary 1920x1080 scale1, secondary -1710x-27 scale2); windows lists 13 on-screen windows with empty titles under no screen-capture permission; click/type blocked exit 3 structured

actual.environment: arm64 macOS 27.0.1, node v24.15.0; electron suite used build-8lWx61 packaged dsh CLI, user-data skin-center 0.4.x plugin dir and reviewed maid-atelier skin dir

notYetDone: real click/type/scroll/screenshot with granted permissions (requires formal MuMa app granted Screen Recording & Accessibility; P06.6 GUI acceptance)
